review.explanation: Review selected PDF pages in a declared order as PNG images, extracted UTF-8 text and crop/rotation metadata. Use this for bounded archival previews and document review. The PDF is captured before execution; fresh native reopening checks every raster and text output. MuPDF renders effective CropBox View appearances with inherited rotation, followed by the requested clockwise quarter turn. Text follows native content order; OCR and arbitrary document editing are outside this route.
pitfalls: PDF text extraction is not OCR or a reading-order guarantee.
Passive rendering does not establish that the source PDF is safe to open in other software.
Page numbers are one-based and must be unique.

fields.explanation: A passive local PDF review request: select unique ordered pages and a raster density, then inspect PNG, extracted text and source-bound page metadata. This does not sanitize or rewrite the PDF.

/properties/version.explanation: Required document contract schemaxis.mupdf/1. This identifies the authored JSON model, independently of the configured MuPDF release.

/properties/operation.explanation: Select review to publish ordered page PNGs, extracted text and crop/rotation metadata. No other PDF transformation or native command is accepted.

/properties/source.explanation: Required absolute local .pdf path, captured as an immutable regular-file snapshot before native parsing. Relative paths, URLs, symlinks at the file leaf, encrypted PDFs and files over 16 MiB are rejected. Reuse identity includes the captured source bytes.

/properties/pages.explanation: Required ordered list of 1–16 distinct one-based page numbers. For example [2,1,3] reviews page 2 first. Numbers must exist in the native document of at most 128 total pages; selection does not alter the original PDF.

/properties/pages/items.explanation: One one-based PDF page number in output order, from 1 to 128. Duplicate page selections are rejected; the whole document may have fewer pages, checked before rendering.

/properties/dpi.explanation: Raster pixels per inch, 36–300; omission selects 72, where a PDF point is one pixel before UserUnit. Doubling density doubles each image dimension and approximately quadruples pixels. Reduce density or selection when the 4096-pixel dimension or 16,777,216 combined-pixel bound is exceeded. PNG density tags are set to the requested DPI and rounded to whole pixels per metre.

/properties/rotation.explanation: Additional clockwise output rotation in degrees: 0,90,180 or270; omission selects 0. Applied after the PDF effective crop/inherited rotation. A 90/270 turn exchanges output width and height; extracted text content/order is unchanged.
